title: Privacy Policy
description: Privacy policy for {{COMPANY_NAME}}: how we handle contact inquiries and personal information.
body:
At {{COMPANY_NAME}}, we respect your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard information submitted through {{SITE_URL}}.

## 1. Studio Details

{{COMPANY_FULL_NAME}} operates from {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}. For any privacy or data requests, contact us at {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}.

## 2. Information We Collect

When you submit a project inquiry or contact us via email or WhatsApp, we collect the details you voluntarily provide, including your name, email address, selected service, optional budget range, and project description.

## 3. How We Use Information

We use your inquiry details strictly to respond to project requests, prepare proposals or estimates, deliver contracted web development or maintenance services, and provide technical support. We never sell or rent your contact details to third parties.

## 4. Analytics & Cookies

Essential storage may be used to preserve site preferences. Optional analytics tools are loaded only if configured and permitted through cookie preferences.

## 5. Data Retention & Your Rights

We retain inquiry records only as long as needed to communicate about your project or maintain active service agreements. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your inquiry details at any time by writing to {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}.

## 6. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as our services evolve. The latest version will always be published on this page.
